# Swift 5.9+ Architecture & Structured Concurrency

Architect performant, thread-safe Swift applications using modern actors, ARC memory management, and structured concurrency.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Enforce the **Actor model** to isolate mutable state and eliminate data races at compile time.
- Use structured concurrency (`async/await` and `withTaskGroup`) instead of unstructured dispatch queues.
- Prevent retain cycles in closures and delegates using explicit `[weak self]` or `[unowned self]`.
- Leverage Swift Package Manager (SPM) with pinned semantic versions.
